title: @angular/core v20 reaches end of life on 2026-11-28
summary: Angular's release schedule lists v20 as LTS with "LTS ends 2026-11-28". LTS receives only critical fixes and security patches until that date.

constraints: Update one major at a time. Each target major must be supported when you run ng update.
Keep @angular/core, @angular/cli, and every other @angular/* package on the same major.

steps.title: Update to Angular v21
steps.instructions: Run `ng update @angular/core@21 @angular/cli@21`, then apply the v21 steps in the Angular Update Guide, including the required TypeScript and Node.js versions.

steps.title: Update to Angular v22
steps.instructions: After the v21 build and tests pass, run `ng update @angular/core@22 @angular/cli@22` and apply the v22 steps in the Angular Update Guide.

steps.title: Review changed Angular APIs
steps.instructions: Check each reported @angular/core import against the Angular Update Guide for removed, renamed, or changed APIs.

verification.purpose: Confirm that @angular/core resolves to the target major.
Build the application on the target major.
Run the unit tests when the project defines them.
